name: Lefay Resort & Spa Lago di Garda
positioning: Environmentally minded wellness resort in a natural park on the hills above Lake Garda in Gargnano, built around the Lefay SPA Method
best_for: Travelers wanting a doctor-guided spa and wellness stay
Couples who want a lake view and a balcony or terrace from every room

facts.text: The resort is in Gargnano, in the heart of the Riviera dei Limoni on Lake Garda.
The resort sits in 11 hectares of natural park, with woods and olive groves overlooking the lake.
The resort was founded by Alcide and Liliana Leali, the founders of Air Dolomiti.
The resort produces more than 75 per cent of its own electricity.
The Lefay SPA Method blends Traditional Chinese Medicine and Western techniques under the guidance of a scientific committee.
Arrival consultations are with qualified doctors, usually trained in both Western and complementary medicine.
The spa has heated indoor and outdoor pools, plus training, ice and thalassotherapy pools and garden whirlpools.
The spa has 21 treatment rooms, half of them with lake views.
The gym has a personal training studio and smaller yoga and tai chi studios.
Suites have furniture and floors made from walnut and olive woods.
Gramen is the resort's plant- and fish-based fine-dining restaurant, with tasting menus inspired by the Energy and Therapeutic Garden around it.
Most meals are taken in La Limonaia, which has wide decks with lake views.

highlights.text: The salt lake is a private floatation pool in a candle-lit cave, with loungers and experience showers.
The resort's design is based on the tiered lemon groves typical of the region.
All rooms overlook Lake Garda and have a balcony or terrace.
The resort has a Five Elements meditative trail.
Massages can be taken outdoors in private gazebos.

considerations.text: The resort is set into a mountainside overlooking Lake Garda, not on the shore.
WhataHotel notes the secluded hillside location means you need transportation to reach nearby towns.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
